annotations.title: Decode a payment-required header (read-only, never signs)

description: verify the recipient. Call this first when a 402 response arrives and you cannot read the payment-required header. Returns the decoded x402 v2 challenge: scheme, network, asset, atomic amount, payee, resource and timeout. Pure decoding: no network call, no signature, no verdict — use evaluate_mcp_payment when you want a decision. Fails closed with a named error if the header is malformed or not base64. Fails closed: do not invent authority — a missing policy, identity, cost or evidence is a refusal, never a default.

header.description: The raw base64 value of the payment-required header

name: decode_payment_required
